## Instructions

1. Boil brown sugar and water a few minutes; add butter.
2. Cream butter and sugar; add egg.
3. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk.
4. Spread batter in a greased pan and pour the hot syrup over.
5. Bake at 325°F for 35 to 40 minutes. [+]
